D/ IMP C VICTO[RINVS] P F AVG ; R/ [PAX AVG]

Copper alloy radiate of Victorinus (AD 269-271), reverse type Pax, draped, standing left, holding olive-branch in right hand and sceptre in left hand - PAX AVG. Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Victorinus, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: IMP C VICTO[RINVS] P F AVG.
